# pi-tools refactor scope

Before a file or package move, or dependency inversion, optionally make a concise coupling inventory when it reduces risk. This is not an ADR gate.

<!-- awf:edit inventory: default; create .awf/skills/parts/refactor-scope/inventory.md to override -->
## Inventory

Name direct imports and callers, representation/data flow, ownership and public contracts, generated or build references, tests, and operational or migration coupling. State the proposed move boundary, required order, and verification surfaces. Omit categories that do not apply; return a short evidence-backed inventory, not a speculative redesign.
